items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: Joe Romano and I had a group there, like for a whole year.

ctx.x: You owned a club too, didn’t you?

Yeah, I had two actually. The first one was in the mid-60s it was a coffee house. I couldn’t get a booze license. That lasted about a year and it was great. People, we’d stay open until six in the morning, after the bars closed, they’d all line up and have steak and eggs at my place and hear music all night. Joe Romano and I had a group there, like for a whole year. But then the last venture was about ‘82, and I had the whole ball of wax then, the bar and the booze and the whole thing. But it was in a bad area,…
